entradas.text: I entered the car and we drove to our residence in Lachaven. Serge took the seaside route.
entradas.menu: Enter the car.

entradas.text: “Go ahead, I'm all ears.”
entradas.menu: “I'm all ears.”

entradas.text: “Sure, if you have to.”
entradas.menu: “Sure, if you have to.”

entradas.text: Walter lit his cigar and took a few drags before continuing.
“The consensus is that we see eye to eye in the economic direction you have taken by promoting a market economy.”
“Many in the group are disappointed in the economic direction that you took by promoting an inefficient planned economy.”
“I'm glad that the group is supportive of the decision. It was calculated.”
entradas.menu: “I'm glad that the group is supportive.”

entradas.text: “I want the situation to be resolved. What can be done to amend the situation?”
entradas.menu: “What can be done to amend the situation?”

entradas.text: “Promises made during the election had to be upheld. That was the main reason behind the decision.”
entradas.menu: “Promises made during the election had to be upheld. That was the main reason behind the decision.”

entradas.text: “The opinions of the Lotherberg group don't concern me. I will make choices on my own accord.”
entradas.menu: “The opinions of the Lotherberg group don't concern me. I will make choices on my own accord.”

entradas.text: “If the administration were to pass a private corporation tax cut and privatise both healthcare and education, it would do wonders in the attitude of Lotherberg towards the administration.”
“Dissatisfaction of Lotherberg should concern you, Mr. President. It should concern you very much. Especially after you took our 'contribution' and didn't act on it.”
“They represent a large collective of economic power. Cooperation would be helpful in solving the recession.”
Walter didn't look satisfied.
“Political motivations are admirable but economics is about numbers and the current reality, not the past.”
“I will give large private corporations a tax reduction.”
entradas.menu: “I will give large private corporations a tax reduction.” [Promise Tax Cut]

entradas.text: “I will make tax decisions objectively. Can't promise you anything.”
entradas.menu: “I will make tax decisions objectively. Can't promise you anything.”

entradas.text: “I'm very satisfied to hear this. To us and the prosperous future of Sordland!”
“Oh let's not be hasty. The recession will end if Lotherberg is on your side, President.”
“It's hard to argue against compromise.”
“Maybe meeting in the middle is the solution.”
entradas.menu: “Maybe meeting in the middle is the solution.”

entradas.text: “This time it isn't. I won't change my mind.”
entradas.menu: “This time it isn't. I won't change my mind.”

entradas.text: Walter smiled.
Walter left and Serge came to pick me up.
“It seems that you have decided to tackle the Old Guard in the new Constitution. That is brave indeed.”
"We are really concerned about the state of emergency. We found ourselves worrying about the future."
“Finally a President that listens to the people. It won't be easy to pass the new Constitution through the Assembly and the Supreme Court.”
"We could be a strong ally in breaking that status quo, if you fulfil our requests. We can help with the Assembly and perhaps the Court..."
“We could help you get it through, if you in return help us with a few economic requests.”
“We need stability for business to function. So if you want us on your side with our capital there are a few requests on our end.”
“We had a deal about the first mega infrastructure project.”
“You rejected our previous discrete offer to pick Underhall Construction for the execution of the first mega infrastructure project.”
“You held on to that promise and awarded the contract to Underhall Construction. This went well in our book.”
“You broke that promise and didn't award the contract to Underhall Construction. This action led to a huge disappointment in the Group.”
“However, you still made the right choice. Your party not getting that donation is unfortunate though. Why someone wouldn't want that money is beyond me.”
“We are aware of the upcoming tax meeting and it would be a step in the right direction if private corporations would get a tax cut.”
“To boost the economy with job creation, of course... And the positive side effect would be our support to the administration throughout the entire term.”
“Usually the Lotherberg spokesman doesn't directly comment on the administration, but I'd like to say a few things since this was a special evening.”
“This action led to disappointment in the Group.”
“From our end the previous mishap would be cleared and confidence in the new administration from the business community would be restored.”
“I'm interested to collaborate further in our shared interests.”
entradas.menu: “I'm interested to collaborate further in our shared interests.”

entradas.text: “I will give a private corporation tax cut and enable privatization in health and education.”
entradas.menu: “I will give a private corporation tax cut and enable privatization in health and education.” [Promise Tax Cut]

entradas.text: “I will make tax and privatization decisions objectively. Can't promise you anything.”
entradas.menu: “I will make tax and privatization decisions objectively. Can't promise you anything.”

entradas.text: “Privatization can lead to a many good things, President Rayne. It is certainly an opportunity to raise further money inside the welfare branches.”
He smiled.
There was an awkward silence.
He gestured at the guards and then called me inside the small VIP lounge.
He called me inside the small VIP lounge.
“President. A moment alone please.”
“Either way... President, we are here and always ready to work with you if you change your mind. Don't forget that.”
“I would want a financial contribution from your end.”
entradas.menu: “[Request Bribe] I would want a financial contribution from your end.”

entradas.text: “We are certainly interested in maintaining a good relationship with Lotherberg.”
entradas.menu: “We are certainly interested in maintaining a good relationship with Lotherberg.”

entradas.text: “Good to know but not sure how this concerns me.”
entradas.menu: “Good to know but not sure how this concerns me.”

entradas.text: “We don't share similar interests with Lotherberg.”
entradas.menu: “We don't share similar interests with Lotherberg.”

entradas.text: “Then we have the right attitude!”
“Oh it definitely should, President.”
“In that case we can move towards a better future together.”
“Yet we live in the same country don't we? Let's settle our differences.”
He looked me in the eye.
“There are many who put their trust in you.”
“I will think about it but not now.”
entradas.menu: “I will think about it but not now.”

entradas.text: “There is nothing to work together on. Good evening.”
entradas.menu: “There is nothing to work together on. Good evening.”

entradas.text: “It is assuring to know that we are allies.”
entradas.menu: “It is assuring to know that we are allies.”

entradas.text: “Glad we could come to an agreement, Walter.”
entradas.menu: “Glad we could come to an agreement, Walter.”

entradas.text: “The last time obviously caused some trust issues between us. We would love to contribute in the future if you agree to the terms.”
“That's a shame. I did offer you a peace branch.”
“Why can't we all just be friends?”
“I don't think so, I have other plans for the economy.”
entradas.menu: “I don't think so, I have other plans for the economy.”

entradas.text: "Maybe we can. I'll see what I can do."
entradas.menu: "Maybe we can. I'll see what I can do."

entradas.text: “Excellent! Glad to hear this.”
“The group wants a private corporation tax cut and privatization in healthcare and education.”
“The only thing the Group wants is a private corporation tax cut and we will fully support your administration.”
“I will give a private corporation tax cut and enable privatization in health and education.”
entradas.menu: “I will give a private corporation tax cut and enable privatization in health and education.” [Promise Tax Cut]

entradas.text: “That is too much of an ask. On third thought, I have to reject.”
entradas.menu: “That is too much of an ask. On third thought, I have to reject.”

entradas.text: “I will pass a private corporation tax cut.”
entradas.menu: “I will pass a private corporation tax cut.” [Promise Tax Cut]

entradas.text: “That is too much of an ask. On third thought, I have to reject.”
entradas.menu: “That is too much of an ask. On third thought, I have to reject.”

entradas.text: “See you, President.”
We were in Lachaven to work with the Business Council to assess weaknesses in the economy. Symon organised a dinner with the affluent economic figureheads of Sordland.
Beaming with pride, he led us to a private room and got us seated at a large table, covered for the occasion with a maroon tablecloth.
When we arrived, the streets were quiet and police forces were patrolling everywhere. The emergency was felt in the vacant city.
When we arrived, the streets were bustling with activity even though the atmosphere in the country was tense. Lachaveners didn't seem very worried.
Together with Walter Tusk, Edith Agnoc, Mikail Aven and Symon Holl, we entered the renowned Esteria restaurant by the coast.
A short blonde man whose embroidered pocket read "Manager," greeted us and waved his arms in excitement as he told us how pleased he was to have us in his establishment.
We were quickly served by a group of servers. Walter spoke as they started taking our orders.
“I recommend the Lachaven Salmon, President. You have to taste this local delicacy here, the best in Sordland."
"No need for that. I hope everybody enjoys the evening."
“Don't get me wrong, Mr. Tusk, but of course I've tasted this greatness many times here already.
entradas.menu: “Don't get me wrong, Mr. Tusk, but of course I've tasted this greatness many times here already.

entradas.text: “I recommend the Lachaven Salmon of this place, President. I know that you're from Lachaven, but I bet you haven't tasted anything like this before."
I ordered Lachaven Salmon for the main course. The servers took their notes and asked about the second dish.
entradas.menu: Order Lachaven Salmon.

entradas.text: I ordered Lespian pasta for the main course. The servers took their notes and asked about the second dish.
entradas.menu: Order Lespian Pasta.

entradas.text: “I appreciate the advice but I don't like salmon."
entradas.menu: “I appreciate the advice but I don't like salmon."

entradas.text: I ordered traditional Sordish bean stew for the main course. The servers took their notes and asked about the second dish.
entradas.menu: Order traditional Sordish bean stew.

entradas.text: “Really? Too bad. I guess that's your loss."
“Excuse me, President. I should have known that a man of your calibre would be a regular at Esteria."
I did not order any other dish and thanked the servers.
entradas.menu: Order no more.

entradas.text: I ordered salad.
entradas.menu: Order salad.

entradas.text: I ordered rice.
entradas.menu: Order rice.

entradas.text: I ordered rice.
entradas.menu: Order rice.

entradas.text: "You should couple that dish with some Lespian salad, President. It's no good when it's by itself."
"That's two starch dishes, President. That's no good."
The servers placed glasses in front of each of us and served bread and water. After they were done taking orders, they quickly left us alone in the private room.
“Thank you but I'm fine."
entradas.menu: “Thank you but I'm fine."

entradas.text: "You're right. I'll get some salad too."
entradas.menu: "You're right. I'll get some salad too."

entradas.text: "Why don't you focus on your own order, Mr. Tusk?"
entradas.menu: "Why don't you focus on your own order, Mr. Tusk?"

entradas.text: "Why don't you focus on your own order, Mr. Tusk?"
entradas.menu: "Why don't you focus on your own order, Mr. Tusk?"

entradas.text: “Thank you, but this is fine."
entradas.menu: “Thank you, but this is fine."

entradas.text: "What is your suggestion?"
entradas.menu: "What is your suggestion?"

entradas.text: One of the servers quickly jumped in the conversation and told me that Mr. Tusk was right, and went on to explain why two starch dishes do not go together. He then offered to prepare me something special.
"It was just a suggestion, President... Come now, relax."
"I only wanted you to have the best possible experience!"
"However you please."
"Good choice."
"No, I want exactly what I ordered."
entradas.menu: "No, I want exactly what I ordered."

entradas.text: "Well... Okay then. Thank you."
entradas.menu: "Well... Okay then. Thank you."

entradas.text: "What is this? Can't I order what I want anymore?"
entradas.menu: "What is this? Can't I order what I want anymore?"

entradas.text: "Oh come on. He is the President! Serve him what he wants!"

The server looked uneasy. He replied, "I'm sorry, Mr. President. This is a very special establishment and we want to provide the best quality service. Therefore, we cannot serve two starch dishes as they do not complement each ot-"
The server respectfully bowed his head and took notes.
After a brief argument, the server agreed to prepare my order and apologized.
“Mr. President, I didn't have the possibility to thank you for coming today. Your presence means a great deal."
"Indeed, sir. It's an honor to dine with you."
“Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: "It's great to be here with the members of the Business Council."
entradas.menu: "It's great to be here with the members of the Business Council."

entradas.text: "Likewise."
entradas.menu: "Likewise."

entradas.text: "We should thank Symon for organizing this meeting."
"Well, it tastes even better! Best of Lespia, the Chateau de Falenco 1934."
"Mr. President?"
Symon gestured at the expensive looking red wine bottle that one of the servers had just brought to the table.
"That looks amazing."
entradas.menu: "That looks amazing."

entradas.text: I nodded at him. He started to carefully pour some wine in my glass and waited for me to taste it before filling it up.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: "Yes?"
entradas.menu: "Yes?"

entradas.text: "No, thank you."
entradas.menu: "No, thank you."

entradas.text: "Do you want some, sir? It is Chateau de Falenco, from 1934."
"Are you serious, Mr. Rayne? Are you going to pass on a Chateau de Falenco 1934?"
"What kind of question is that? Of course."
entradas.menu: "What kind of question is that? Of course."

entradas.text: "Let's try it."
entradas.menu: "Let's try it."

entradas.text: "Thank you, but I'm not going to drink this evening."
entradas.menu: "Thank you, but I'm not going to drink this evening."

entradas.text: "I'd prefer something regional or at least Sordish."
entradas.menu: "I'd prefer something regional or at least Sordish."

entradas.text: "I see. Wine patriotism."
"I have to insist."
After filling everybody's glasses, Symon stood up and raised his glass.
"As I've said, I'm not going to drink."
entradas.menu: "As I've said, I'm not going to drink."

entradas.text: "Fine... I can't turn down a man like you, Mr. Tusk."
entradas.menu: "Fine... I can't turn down a man like you, Mr. Tusk."

entradas.text: "I can't drink now when the country is suffering."
entradas.menu: "I can't drink now when the country is suffering."

entradas.text: He laughed and gestured at the waiter to bring the best Sordish wine that they had.
"It is solved."

The waiter brought a bottle of 'Dandelion.' The world famous red wine from Borin. Symon went ahead and grabbed the bottle from the waiter. He poured some in my glass and waited for me to taste it before filling it up.
"Alright, President. Nobody is forcing you."
"Well said, President."
"Sad times, indeed."
"Sad times, indeed."
"But don't you think you overreacted with this emergency situation?"
Symon cut in.
There was a brief silence at the table before Symon cut in.
"Let's not get ourselves down, gentlemen."
After everybody was served their preferred drinks, Symon stood up with his glass raised.
"I'd like to raise a toast to all of you here today."
"We will get through this period as well."
"We're meeting here tonight in difficult times. But I believe that, with hard work, cooperation and trust..."
"I'd like to thank Mr. Rayne again for his decisiveness when it comes to economic policies... I'm sure we will stop this recession."
"I also thank Mr. Tusk for being here with us today... His presence is an honor."
"And of course, my colleagues from the Business Council, Mrs. Agnoc and Mr. Aven. Without you, none of these would have been possible."
"Let's drink to future cooperation and growth."
"For a prosperous Sordland!"
Everybody raised their glasses and toasted each other.
After a couple of more minutes, the servers arrived with our meals.
When I tasted the food, I went back to my past. It reminded me of my childhood in this city. Even though I couldn't recall much about my father, I remembered that he also loved the food of Esteria.
The food tasted amazing. Walter was right, this place must have been the best place in all of Lachaven.
"So, how did you find the food of the best fine dining restaurant in Lachaven, Mr. President?"
“This can't get old. It's an experience. The chef must be tipped.”
entradas.menu: “This can't get old. It's an experience. The chef must be tipped.”

entradas.text: "Definitely it doesn't. But I will take care of the tip. Don't you worry.”
"Tipping is no small thing. I actually don't like giving tips. People have salaries for a reason.”
“Fine food is like fine art. But this particular one is a masterpiece.”
entradas.menu: “Fine food is like fine art. But this particular one is a masterpiece.”

entradas.text: "It's okay."
entradas.menu: "It's okay."

entradas.text: "I know exactly what you mean. Art is something else, it embodies so much about us and the world surrounding our lives. And food ca-"
"Oh?"
“Says the man visiting one of the finest restaurants in Sordland.”
"There is an art of everything. The art of making money, food, wine and love."
“Always generous when it comes to small things.”
“Don't blame it on him. Mr. President didn't choose the place."
“Not a big fan of fancy food, but I must admit that it's very tasty.”
entradas.menu: “Not a big fan of fancy food, but I must admit that it's very tasty.”

entradas.text: "You didn't like the food?"
"No, I loved it. I just don't like this luxurious fine dining culture."
entradas.menu: "No, I loved it. I just don't like this luxurious fine dining culture."

entradas.text: "I liked it but it is nothing special."
entradas.menu: "I liked it but it is nothing special."

entradas.text: "Oh, I understand what you mean."
"I hope the manager did not hear that."
"How are things going in the Maroon Palace? The pressure must have increased after you attended that funeral."
"But anyway..."
"How are things going in the Maroon Palace? The pressure must have increased after you did not attend that funeral."
"The pressure was already high. Not much has changed."
entradas.menu: "The pressure was already high. Not much has changed."

entradas.text: "It did. But it was the right decision."
entradas.menu: "It did. But it was the right decision."

entradas.text: "I have to say, the future is looking good."
entradas.menu: "I have to say, the future is looking good."

entradas.text: "It's tough but our work on the new constitution continues."
entradas.menu: "It's tough but our work on the new constitution continues."

entradas.text: "It's tough but the new laws will fix it."
entradas.menu: "It's tough but the new laws will fix it."

entradas.text: We were escorted by heavily armed police forces as well as the presidential guard.
"You will get through this."
"Of course. I didn't mean to criticise your decision."
"That's great to hear."
"We all hope so."
As we conversed with Mikail, I heard Walter raise his voice in an apparent argument with Edith and Symon. We both stopped to listen.
"...Arcasia knows the right way of doing business. Their approach to the world is real and raw. I'd prefer that cutthroat approach in comparison to the niceties."
"I mean... It's a nice country to visit too. I have travelled there often in business trips. Their attitude on-"
"Well-"
He smirked.
"All countries are nice to visit if you have the cash."
"Why would you, President? Or why wouldn't you?"
"Where is this pile of gold you keep talking about Walter?"
"By the way..."
“Make sure to lay a good foundation for our negotiations to start on.”
entradas.menu: “Make sure to lay a good foundation for our negotiations to start on.”

entradas.text: “I am looking forward to those visits. It's been a long time since I left the country.”
entradas.menu: “I am looking forward to those visits. It's been a long time since I left the country.”

entradas.text: “Walter is taking us down the rabbit hole again.”
“Our talented team is lead by Mr. Wisci. His wealth of knowledge and extensive connections will aid in our endeavour.”
“Money does turn the world around. Travel is the least you can buy with it.”
entradas.menu: “Money does turn the world around. Travel is the least you can buy with it.”

entradas.text: “Staalport is a relatively calm and nice seaside city. I'm sure you'll like it there.”
“The picture would have been very different.”
"Exactly. How about the people who don't have extra cash to spend?"
entradas.menu: "Exactly. How about the people who don't have extra cash to spend?"

entradas.text: “Certainly not all.”
entradas.menu: “Certainly not all.”

entradas.text: "Can't disagree. The President deserves a better wage."
“Walter is taking us down the rabbit hole again.”
“Old men plant trees whose shade they shall never sit under.”
entradas.menu: “Old men plant trees whose shade they shall never sit under.”

entradas.text: “Hear, hear.”
“Truly an egotistical way to look at the world.”
entradas.menu: “Truly an egotistical way to look at the world.”

entradas.text: “What about disease? What about death? What about everything that is wrong with the world?”
“You are right, Walter. We only live once.”
entradas.menu: “You are right, Walter. We only live once.”

entradas.text: "You work day and night for the nation, surely you deserve a higher salary."
“Half the globe isn't worth our time nor attention. That won't change unless profitability increases.”
"As long as you hold the treasure the country is yours. We are all part of that treasure."
“Power controls money.”
entradas.menu: “Power controls money.”

entradas.text: “Money holds real power.”
entradas.menu: “Money holds real power.”

entradas.text: "So you're saying money is power."
“These are matters beyond our lives. We should focus on the betterment of ourselves and enjoy what we have, instead of worrying about what others don't have.”
“Walter's classic absolutes. But I do agree with you investment-wise. There are only a select group of countries that guarantee a return on investment.”
“The world isn't black and white.”
entradas.menu: “The world isn't black and white.”

entradas.text: “I am not a person to be motivated or influenced by money.”
entradas.menu: “I am not a person to be motivated or influenced by money.”

entradas.text: “There we go! You have to let loose of that burden of yours or it will consume you.”
“Talking of which, we are preparing our visit to Agnolia and Wehlen where we will meet their governments to settle our trade negotiations.”
"We see eye to eye! What a privilege to agree with the President of Sordland himself."
“It's just facts. Life is short and there is only so much we can do. Why not focus all the energy on ourselves?”
“An idealist at heart. You know what they say, being a romantic idealist is easy when you have the time and money to be able to just sit down, relax and dream.”
“You would be surprised how much it is so, it is but a matter of price.”
“Yet rulers always use their treasure to maintain power. If you did not control the Ministry of Economy or the Central Bank...”
Mikail joined in.
entradas.menu: Stay silent.

entradas.text: “Last time I went somewhere for that sort of thing was at university. And even then we had our wild times thanks to Konrath's connected entourage. Also-”
“It certainly depends on what you are looking for. Cultural tourism doesn't require a fancy hotel.”
"I have to congratulate Mr. Rayne for starting such a massive project."
"I saw that Underhall Construction has already started with the highway construction."
"Hopefully that project will bring new investments from Agnolia. The mood is already becoming positive."
"I saw that the construction of the highway has already started. I have my concerns about the company, but I hope they do a good job."
"I expect that the project will bring new investments from Agnolia. The mood is already becoming positive."
"I saw that Underhall Construction has already started with the railway construction."
"That project will surely boost our economy. The mood is already very positive."
"I saw that the construction of the railway has already started. I have my concerns about the company, but I hope they do a good job."
"That project will surely boost our economy if done correctly. The mood is already becoming positive."
"The business bailout package was a great investment. I have already seen some positive results."
Symon poured some wine in my glass and waited for me to taste it before filling it up.
I took a sip.
The taste of the wine was immediately stimulating and delightful to my palate. It immediately reminded me of our visits to my father's vineyard when I was a little kid.
The wine's sweet and bitter flavours exploded in my mouth. The aroma of gooseberries and lilacs tumbled across my tongue, and my mouth tingled with them long after I'd swallowed.
It was bitter.
Honestly, it tasted like any other wine.
"How is it? Is the taste to your liking?"
"It tastes like heaven. Reminds me of my father's vineyard."
entradas.menu: "It tastes like heaven. Reminds me of my father's vineyard."

entradas.text: "How is it? Is the taste to your liking?"
"Fine balance and a nice touch of gooseberries... I like it."
entradas.menu: "Fine balance and a nice touch of gooseberries... I like it."

entradas.text: "It has a sour and delicate vegetal character. Is it Arcasia I'm tasting?"
entradas.menu: "It has a sour and delicate vegetal character. Is it Arcasia I'm tasting?"

entradas.text: "It tastes like heaven."
entradas.menu: "It tastes like heaven."

entradas.text: "It's fine."
entradas.menu: "It's fine."

entradas.text: "It tastes like any other wine."
entradas.menu: "It tastes like any other wine."

entradas.text: "Thank you for your support, Mr. Aven."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your support, Mr. Aven."

entradas.text: "No need for that, Mr. Aven. The State is just doing its job."
entradas.menu: "No need for that, Mr. Aven. The State is just doing its job."

entradas.text: "I hope the investment returns will be great."
entradas.menu: "I hope the investment returns will be great."

entradas.text: "It has already saved many businesses from declaring bankruptcy."
"I have to congratulate Mr. Rayne for spending a massive amount of money for the businesses. This sets a good atmosphere for trust."
"That's good to hear."
entradas.menu: "That's good to hear."

entradas.text: "The relief package was also a great investment. It has already saved many businesses from declaring bankruptcy."
"I have to congratulate Mr. Rayne for such major projects."
"I've heard that you've bought a new villa, Symon."
“Where is the property?”
entradas.menu: “Where is the property?”

entradas.text: “I don't comment on rumours, but I'll make an exception since we are among friends. It's true.”
“You are doing a great job so you deserve it.”
entradas.menu: “You are doing a great job so you deserve it.”

entradas.text: “A new villa is a bit much. Especially in this economy when people are suffering.”
entradas.menu: “A new villa is a bit much. Especially in this economy when people are suffering.”

entradas.text: “Maybe it shows overcompensation somewhat. Everybody is free to do whatever they want.”
entradas.menu: “Maybe it shows overcompensation somewhat. Everybody is free to do whatever they want.”

entradas.text: “Where there is demand there is supply. The market rules supreme as always.”
“It is a small seaside villa at the outskirts of Conriat. It's just a modest house with a swimming pool and a small golf course in the property."
“So what? My car collection is nearing the forty mark. They are all old timer models.”
“He *is* one of the hardest working ministers in the government. He has surely deserved it.”
“Depends who you work for.”
“Rewards give the motivation to ensure people go that extra mile.”
entradas.menu: “Rewards give the motivation to ensure people go that extra mile.”

entradas.text: “But talking about rewards... It is a fact that the government pays far less than the private sector.”
“Great city to buy real estate in. Conriat is seeing a surge of investments.”
entradas.menu: “Great city to buy real estate in. Conriat is seeing a surge of investments.”

entradas.text: "So you're becoming a neighbour to Marcel Koronti?"
entradas.menu: "So you're becoming a neighbour to Marcel Koronti?"

entradas.text: “Underhall Construction made a fortune constructing houses there.”
“Don't expect the rich to become modest in the near future. That would be a pipe dream.”
“That's true but that was a change made on purpose to push for improvements from the inside.”
“I always advocate against ostentatious behaviour. Money shouldn't be wasted for luxury."
entradas.menu: “I always advocate against ostentatious behaviour. Money shouldn't be wasted for luxury."

entradas.text: "I agree."
“Some prefer the carrot and stick approach. I'm more result oriented.”
entradas.menu: “Some prefer the carrot and stick approach. I'm more result oriented.”

entradas.text: "What? No."
"You may be tasting the oak from the barrels, or maybe its the gooseberries. It's definitely not Arcasia, Mr. President."
"See?"
"What? This wine doesn't even need testing."
"Should I fill your glass or would you want another drink, sir?"
"I think I'm good. I won't have anything for now."
entradas.menu: "I think I'm good. I won't have anything for now."

entradas.text: "It's okay. I'll drink it."
entradas.menu: "It's okay. I'll drink it."

entradas.text: "I've heard that he was a big wine connoisseur. May he rest in peace."
"You know your wine, Mr. Rayne. I respect that."
Symon filled up my glass.
"Thank you."
entradas.menu: "Thank you."

entradas.text: "Honestly, I was never close to him. I can't recall too much apart from his lavish parties."
entradas.menu: "Honestly, I was never close to him. I can't recall too much apart from his lavish parties."

entradas.text: I did not reply.
entradas.menu: Stay silent.

entradas.text: "I'm sorry to hear that."
"As you wish, Mr. President."
He grabbed the bottle again to pour some into Walter Tusk's glass.
"You didn't have to serve us, Mr. Holl. There are servers around here."
"I couldn't agree more."
entradas.menu: "I couldn't agree more."

entradas.text: Several of the heavily armed guards were also inside with us, protecting every entrance and exit.
The guards bowed their heads and went outside. Walter sighed in relief.
As all of us started eating. Walter stopped and looked at the guards before turning to me.
"I know that we are in a state of emergency, Mr. Rayne. But can't we even eat alone?"
"What are they protecting here? They have already surrounded the whole restaurant."
"It is a necessity, Mr. Tusk. There's nothing I can do about it."
entradas.menu: "It is a necessity, Mr. Tusk. There's nothing I can do about it."

entradas.text: "They have to be prepared for everything."
entradas.menu: "They have to be prepared for everything."

entradas.text: "I can take them out, if you want, Mr. Tusk."
entradas.menu: "I can take them out, if you want, Mr. Tusk."

entradas.text: "You're right. Can you guys leave us alone here, please?"
entradas.menu: "You're right. Can you guys leave us alone here, please?"

entradas.text: "Please."
"Can you guys leave us alone here, please?"
entradas.menu: "Can you guys leave us alone here, please?"

entradas.text: "You can stay outside the door."
entradas.menu: "You can stay outside the door."

entradas.text: "Please leave the room. You scared Mr. Tusk."
entradas.menu: "Please leave the room. You scared Mr. Tusk."

entradas.text: "I see."
He didn't look too pleased about the whole situation.
"We all hope so, Mr. President. But I think it will work out."
"Of course."
"Mr. Holl also deserves credit, of course. Our *great* economy minister..."
"Is there a joke coming?"
"Why? I thought you said you were great at economy."
He laughed.
"How can you speak like that?"
entradas.menu: "How can you speak like that?"

entradas.text: "Modest? Are you being sarcastic with me?"
entradas.menu: "Modest? Are you being sarcastic with me?"

entradas.text: "I've heard that your father was a very wealthy man."
Edith, who was sitting to my left, gently put her hand over my arm for a few seconds.
"A correction. It wasn't his policies that destroyed him. It was the Old Guard."
"The kid can handle himself. He doesn't need anybody else.”
entradas.menu: "The kid can handle himself. He doesn't need anybody else.”

entradas.text: Everyone went quiet.
"I've heard that you had a difficult life in Deyr. Is that right?"
"That's a good choice. Having a degree in Sordland separates you from the rabble. And we especially need more people who understand economics."
"I've heard that you were brought up in the capital and experienced all the power shift as it happened. Is that right? It must have been tough."
"But I agree that we need more economists to enter politics. It's unfortunate that Ewald Alphonso was the only leader who actually studied economics.”
"My childhood was very difficult. But it definitely made me stronger."
entradas.menu: "My childhood was very difficult. But it definitely made me stronger."

entradas.text: “My family cared for me as much as they could. I couldn't ask for more than that.”
entradas.menu: “My family cared for me as much as they could. I couldn't ask for more than that.”

entradas.text: “I try to leave my past behind and focus on today. It's who we have become that matters.”
entradas.menu: “I try to leave my past behind and focus on today. It's who we have become that matters.”

entradas.text: “Walter stop with the conspiracy theories. I think we've had enough drinks.”
“Talking of which, it's great that we have another leader who actually studied economics and understands it. Like Mr. Alphonso."
“He threatened their economic power base over the country through a vast privatization plan. They removed him and backed you after.”
“True, but I think it was his ambition that brought him down. Too many big changes in a short time frame.”
“That's what I say after a good night of drinking.”
“I always had a gut feeling about his sudden fall.”
entradas.menu: “I always had a gut feeling about his sudden fall.”

entradas.text: “Sometimes it impacts people more negatively. My father used to beat me up good when I crossed the line.”
"Of course it was. They are a big threat."
entradas.menu: "Of course it was. They are a big threat."

entradas.text: "That's very humble of you."
“What do you mean?”
entradas.menu: “What do you mean?”

entradas.text: “I never met your family, Mr. President. How are they doing, if you don't mind me asking?”
“Look at what he caused. Studying doesn't get you to the finish line.”
entradas.menu: “Look at what he caused. Studying doesn't get you to the finish line.”

entradas.text: “We are here because of him. I don't think we had a chance, if he hadn't screwed up.”
"We don't talk much since I became President."
entradas.menu: "We don't talk much since I became President."

entradas.text: "It can happen. Sometimes work can get in the way. Don't stress yourself over it."
"Well, the rascal didn't even ask for permission to use the yacht and just took it. He basically stole it..."
"I prefer not to talk about my family."
entradas.menu: "I prefer not to talk about my family."

entradas.text: “We are in this mess because of him. His political failure nearly destroyed us.”
entradas.menu: “We are in this mess because of him. His political failure nearly destroyed us.”

entradas.text: "He is going through the teenager period. It's difficult to connect with him, he's a little shy."
entradas.menu: "He is going through the teenager period. It's difficult to connect with him, he's a little shy."

entradas.text: "Mikail. What did you just say to me?"
entradas.menu: "Mikail. What did you just say to me?"

entradas.text: “Alphonso was an inspiration for all reformists."
entradas.menu: “Alphonso was an inspiration for all reformists."

entradas.text: “Wish that was my son's biggest problem...”
"Darron seemed to be doing fine. I saw that his yacht party in Benfi made the local news."
“He was, he truly wanted to transform this country to a modern nation. His term was very difficult though. He got destroyed.”
“Family is everything. My advice would be to make sure that Franc has a solid relationship with you. He is your future, after all."
"I said that about my daughter too. And she dropped out of university..."
“I'm trying my best to be a good father to him. He seems to be somewhat introverted.”
entradas.menu: “I'm trying my best to be a good father to him. He seems to be somewhat introverted.”

entradas.text: "We'll see about that."
entradas.menu: "We'll see about that."

entradas.text: "Some people are more sensible. I believe balance is possible."
entradas.menu: "Some people are more sensible. I believe balance is possible."

entradas.text: "The gap between the rich and the poor is the root cause of this."
entradas.menu: "The gap between the rich and the poor is the root cause of this."

entradas.text: “Some of us are more sensible than others. Balance is possible.”
"Why?"
entradas.menu: "Why?"

entradas.text: "I already had my eye on the area. Plus it wasn't intended to be public."
"Come on, let's not talk about finance or politics for now. We came here to relax."
"I'm just saying that he's free to do what he please with his hard earned money."
"What's that supposed to mean?"
"Not really. His place is very remote."
"Conriat has a way of pulling certain people in, it seems."
"No. Is there a problem?"
"Oh come on! Leave the man be, President."
"Isn't that right, gentlemen?"
She turned to Walter and Symon.
They nodded at her and took a sip from their drinks. She slightly leaned towards me.
"So, Mr. Rayne, why don't you tell us what's behind that strong character of yours?"
"It didn't contribute much. My success has nothing to do with that."
entradas.menu: "It didn't contribute much. My success has nothing to do with that."

entradas.text: “Would you say that it contributed a lot to your success?"
"It was difficult times in the capital. But I've learned a lot about politics."
entradas.menu: "It was difficult times in the capital. But I've learned a lot about politics."

entradas.text: "I didn't suffer much thanks to my family. We didn't have much but we were stable."
entradas.menu: "I didn't suffer much thanks to my family. We didn't have much but we were stable."

entradas.text: "It all makes sense now!"
"It certainly helped. Money opened a lot of doors."
entradas.menu: "It certainly helped. Money opened a lot of doors."

entradas.text: "We had money but we weren't happy. I learned a lot about life thanks to my absent father."
entradas.menu: "We had money but we weren't happy. I learned a lot about life thanks to my absent father."

entradas.text: "Of course not. You've worked hard for it. After all, money can't buy diligence."
"Of course it did. What kind of question is that, Edith?"
"I'm sorry to hear that."
"They're doing great. We have no problems."
entradas.menu: "They're doing great. We have no problems."

entradas.text: "I understand."
"That's great to hear. Your son must be very proud of you."
“Family is everything. My advice would be to make sure that Franc has a solid relationship with you. He is your future, after all."
"I said: I don't want to talk about my family."
entradas.menu: "I said: I don't want to talk about my family."

entradas.text: "I'm sorry, President. Let me know if I can help with anything."
"Why do you even care?"
entradas.menu: "Why do you even care?"

entradas.text: "I'm just giving advice, President!"
"Nobody would want a son that steals your yacht and make the local news."
"Good news is that I finally convinced him to go to university. He will study economics in Lachaven Business School."
He looked at Mikail.
"Maybe your son will be a great future economist!"
"I wouldn't count on that."
"Not that I mean anything against you, Mr. Rayne."
He turned to me.
"I'm very confident in your abilities to fix our recession."
"Thank you."
entradas.menu: "Thank you."

entradas.text: "I hope we can repair the damages to our economy. We can't fail like Alphonso did."
"I believe that too."
entradas.menu: "I believe that too."

entradas.text: "Maybe you should help Mikail instead. I saw Darron made the local news with his yacht party in Benfi."
She looked at Mikail.
Walter looked at the guards inside the room.
"A correction. It wasn't his policies that destroyed him."
“What do you mean?”
entradas.menu: “What do you mean?”

entradas.text: “I always had a bad feeling about his sudden fall.”
entradas.menu: “I always had a bad feeling about his sudden fall.”

entradas.text: “Everybody knows that.”
entradas.menu: “Everybody knows that.”

entradas.text: "Let's just say that he threatened the economic power base of some powerful figures within the government with his vast privatization plan. And they removed him."
"And?"
entradas.menu: "And?"

entradas.text: "And now they're backing you."
He lowered his voice.
"You don't want to say this again in public."
entradas.menu: "You don't want to say this again in public."

entradas.text: There was a brief silence.
After a long silence, followed by some chit-chat, Walter ordered a bottle of whiskey.
“Symon would you give a toast again?”
entradas.menu: “Symon would you give a toast again?”

entradas.text: “Sure.”
"That's one good looking bottle."
The waiters brought one of the finest Arcasian whiskeys. It was time for a toast.
“I raise to our health and happiness. The two things that one needs for a happy life.”
entradas.menu: “I raise to our health and happiness.”

entradas.text: “To a constructive and beneficial future! May our differences be set aside for a good future.”
entradas.menu: “To a constructive and beneficial future!”

entradas.text: “To our wealth and success! Let's be honest, that's all that truly matters to any of us.”
entradas.menu: “To our wealth and success!”

entradas.text: Edith stood up. Most of us were all a little tipsy at this point.
“I agree.”
The moon was shining bright as everyone except Walter left in their luxury cars.
“It's getting late. Let's call it a night.”
entradas.menu: “It's getting late. Let's call it a night.”

entradas.text: “I would gladly drink to that.”
“Me too.”
“Cheers to that.”
“Aye.”
“They say hope dies last, to the future.”
“I think it's time we call it a night.”
“I want to thank you, Mr. President for joining us and you Symon, for putting all this together.”
“Raised.”
“May the wheels of fortune always turn in our favour! The future of abundance awaits us!"
"That's definitely not me."
“Good night everybody. It was a pleasure.”
"Thank you Edith, for joining with a bunch of ugly rich men."
entradas.menu: "Thank you Edith, for joining with a bunch of ugly rich men."

entradas.text: "The President of jokes."
I stood up to give a toast.
entradas.menu: Toast.

entradas.text: "I'm not going to drink."
entradas.menu: "I'm not going to drink."

entradas.text: Symon stood up. He seemed to have a slight issue with his balance.
“To an equal society without class differences. A Morgna wes core!"
entradas.menu: “To an equal society without class differences. A Morgna wes core!"

entradas.text: Nobody else responded. And Symon looked like he had a little too much alcohol.
"Aye!"
There was an awkward silence as they looked at each other with glasses in their hands.
"Vectern sis da..."
"Fine."
"Let's just drink this up and leave."
"Symon?"
"Thank you all for being here."
entradas.menu: "Thank you all for being here."

entradas.text: "Thank you."
"It was great."
"Thanks for being here."
After bidding our farewells, we slowly walked out the restaurant.
“You rejected our previous discrete offer to bail out businesses.”
“We had a deal about the business bailout package."
“You held on to that promise. This went well in our book.”
“This action led to disappointment in the Group.”
“However, you still made the right choice. Your party not getting that donation is unfortunate though. Why someone wouldn't want that money is beyond me.”
“You broke that promise. This action led to a huge disappointment in the Group.”
"What's that supposed to mean?"
entradas.menu: "What's that supposed to mean?"

entradas.text: "Oh. N-Nothing, Mr. President. I'm sorry if it came across wrong."
The table went quiet for a few seconds.
Walter stared at me as the guards bowed their heads and went outside.
"I'd like to thank Mr. Rayne again for his decisiveness in office... I'm sure we will get through this emergency period and come out stronger."
"What do you want?"
entradas.menu: "What do you want?"

entradas.text: I followed him inside.
entradas.menu: Follow him.

entradas.text: I ignored him.
entradas.menu: Ignore him and leave.

entradas.text: “I couldn't care less.”
entradas.menu: “I couldn't care less.”

entradas.text: “Oh but you definitely should, President.”
“I don't want to hear your comments, Mr. Tusk.”
entradas.menu: “I don't want to hear your comments, Mr. Tusk.”

entradas.text: “You don't mean that.”
“The comments of the Lotherberg Group should matter to you, President.”
“Please let me briefly explain myself.”
"Maybe some other time. Good evening."
entradas.menu: "Maybe some other time. Good evening."

entradas.text: I ignored him and left.
“Lotherberg will not influence me.”
entradas.menu: “Lotherberg will not influence me.”

entradas.text: Everyone fell silent and looked at Mikail.
"Oh, excuse him, President! He didn't mean anything bad."
"Er... No. I didn't mean t-"
Walter laughed and Mikail joined in with a nervous laughter soon after.
“Enough with this Alphonso talk. His policies already destroyed him."
"Fine."
entradas.menu: "Fine."

entradas.text: "No. What did he just say?"
entradas.menu: "No. What did he just say?"

entradas.text: Nobody responded.
"I thought so."
entradas.menu: "I thought so."

entradas.text: "WILL SOMEBODY ANSWER ME?"
entradas.menu: "WILL SOMEBODY ANSWER ME?"

entradas.text: "Looks like a cat caught our friend's tongue."
entradas.menu: "Looks like a cat caught our friend's tongue."

entradas.text: "No need to shout at the table, Mr. President."
"Enough. I'm done with this dinner."
entradas.menu: "Enough. I'm done with this dinner."

entradas.text: "You still didn't give me a response."
entradas.menu: "You still didn't give me a response."

entradas.text: "I said 'Ewald Alphonso was the only leader who was well-versed in economics'. Please forgive me, I didn't mean to offend you."
"Fine. Watch your words next time."
entradas.menu: "Fine. Watch your words next time."

entradas.text: I stood up and left the room.
Walter came running behind me as I walked outside.
"But I agree that we need more economists to enter politics. Thankfully we have a president who seems to be as well-versed in economics as Alphonso.”
“I appreciate the advice but I don't like salmon."
entradas.menu: “I appreciate the advice but I don't like salmon."

entradas.text: “Really? As a Lachavener, too?"
“I guess that's your loss."
He turned to me.
"Ah, of course. Nobody can say no to a bottle of wine by Giralt of Ribery."
